## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: /cleanup-feature, /merge-pull-requests, /validate-feature (deploy/teardown),...

The system SHALL ensure that /cleanup-feature, /merge-pull-requests, /validate-feature (deploy/teardown), and the autopilot SUBMIT_PR step record every listed effect via begin/complete/fail.

#### Scenario: /cleanup-feature, /merge-pull-requests, /validate-feature (deploy/teardown),...

WHEN `route-skill-side-effects-through-the-effects-journal` is implemented
THEN /cleanup-feature, /merge-pull-requests, /validate-feature (deploy/teardown), and the autopilot SUBMIT_PR step record every listed effect via begin/complete/fail.

### Requirement: Re-running SUBMIT_PR after a crash with a started entry finds the existing...

The system SHALL ensure that re-running SUBMIT_PR after a crash with a started entry finds the existing PR for the head branch and records completed without creating a second PR.

#### Scenario: Re-running SUBMIT_PR after a crash with a started entry finds the existing...

WHEN `route-skill-side-effects-through-the-effects-journal` is implemented
THEN Re-running SUBMIT_PR after a crash with a started entry finds the existing PR for the head branch and records completed without creating a second PR.

### Requirement: A guard test fails when gh pr create, git push, merge APIs, or deploy entry...

The system SHALL ensure that a guard test fails when gh pr create, git push, merge APIs, or deploy entry points are invoked from a skill script outside an effects-journal wrapper.

#### Scenario: A guard test fails when gh pr create, git push, merge APIs, or deploy entry...

WHEN `route-skill-side-effects-through-the-effects-journal` is implemented
THEN A guard test fails when gh pr create, git push, merge APIs, or deploy entry points are invoked from a skill script outside an effects-journal wrapper.

### Requirement: Behavior is unchanged in sequential, local-parallel, and coordinated tiers...

The system SHALL ensure that behavior is unchanged in sequential, local-parallel, and coordinated tiers and in cloud-harness environments.

#### Scenario: Behavior is unchanged in sequential, local-parallel, and coordinated tiers...

WHEN `route-skill-side-effects-through-the-effects-journal` is implemented
THEN Behavior is unchanged in sequential, local-parallel, and coordinated tiers and in cloud-harness environments.
